answer: A strong defense ties identity to a costly kernel of work: before bidding or voting, each agent must lock a small stake and finish a unique, time-bound task that cannot be parallelized across fake identities. Hollow accounts gain nothing by cloning themselves, because every copy pays the same stake and does the same work. Honest agents earn reputation only through completed, audited deals. Like yarrow spreading slowly through a field, trust grows gradually from proven history, so a Sybil swarm cannot buy instant influence without paying for each identity it creates.
